speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Up, the three of you. A Sunday ends upstairs. It does not end in another telling at my board.

speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
text: I have told it. I can go up without it.

speaker: susanna_shakespeare
text: The book stays on the shelf. I am not taking it upstairs to improve a question.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go up. I am not making the stair into another telling.
